rules.rule_name: Session Validation and Sign-On Redirect
rules.rule_description: Ensures that a valid active session exists before allowing access to the Transaction View screen. If no session context is present, the user is redirected to the Sign-On screen.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user attempts to access the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.When: No active session context exists (communication area length is zero)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system redirects the user to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C) and the Transaction View screen is not displayed

rules.rule_name: Pre-Selected Transaction Auto-Load
rules.rule_description: When a user navigates to the Transaction View screen from a transaction list with a transaction already selected, the system automatically pre-populates the Transaction ID field and performs the lookup without requiring the user to manually enter the Transaction ID and press Enter.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid session exists and the user is entering the Transaction View screen for the first time
acceptance_criteria.When: A pre-selected Transaction ID has been passed in from the calling screen (CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED is not spaces or low-values)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system pre-populates the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINI) with the pre-selected Transaction ID and automatically executes the transaction lookup process (PROCESS-ENTER-KEY) without requiring the user to press Enter

rules.rule_name: Transaction View Screen Initialization on First Entry
rules.rule_description: On the first entry to the Transaction View screen, the screen is initialized in a clean state with the cursor positioned at the Transaction ID input field, ready for user input.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid session exists and the user is accessing the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.When: This is the first time the user is entering the screen (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is false)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the screen as re-enterable (sets CDEMO-PGM-REENTER to TRUE), clears all screen output fields (COTRN1AO set to LOW-VALUES), positions the cursor at the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINL set to -1), and displays the Transaction View screen

rules.rule_name: User Input Capture on Returning Screen Entry
rules.rule_description: On subsequent visits to the Transaction View screen, the system captures all data entered by the user from the screen before processing any actions.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid session exists and the user has previously been presented with the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits input by pressing any key (the screen is in re-enterable state, CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system receives and captures all user-entered data from the Transaction View screen (MAP COTRN1A, MAPSET COTRN01) into the input data structure (COTRN1AI) for subsequent processing

rules.rule_name: Transaction ID Mandatory Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the Transaction ID field is not empty before attempting a transaction lookup. The Transaction ID is a required field for searching transaction records.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction View screen and has pressed the Enter key to search for a transaction
acceptance_criteria.When: The Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINI) contains only spaces or low-values (is empty)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Tran ID can NOT be empty...', positions the cursor back to the Transaction ID field (TRNIDINL set to -1), and redisplays the Transaction View screen without performing any lookup

rules.rule_name: Transaction Record Lookup by Transaction ID
rules.rule_description: Retrieves a transaction record from the Transaction data store using the entered Transaction ID as the search key. Handles both successful retrieval and not-found scenarios with appropriate user feedback.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a non-empty Transaction ID on the Transaction View screen and pressed Enter
acceptance_criteria.When: The system searches the TRANSACT VSAM file for a record matching the entered Transaction ID (TRAN-ID)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the transaction is found, the system retrieves the full transaction record and continues to display the details; if the Transaction ID does not match any record, the system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Transaction ID NOT found...', positions the cursor at the Transaction ID field (TRNIDINL set to -1), and redisplays the screen without transaction details

rules.rule_name: Transaction Details Display After Successful Lookup
rules.rule_description: After a successful transaction record retrieval, all transaction details are mapped to the screen display fields and presented to the user.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully retrieved from the TRANSACT file using the entered Transaction ID
acceptance_criteria.When: No errors exist after the transaction lookup (ERR-FLG-ON is false)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the following screen display fields: Transaction ID (TRNIDI), Card Number (CARDNUMI), Transaction Type Code (TTYPCDI), Transaction Category Code (TCATCDI), Transaction Source (TRNSRCI), Transaction Amount (TRNAMTI - formatted), Transaction Description (TDESCI), Original Transaction Timestamp (TORIGDTI), Processed Transaction Timestamp (TPROCDTI), Merchant ID (MIDI), Merchant Name (MNAMEI), Merchant City (MCITYI), and Merchant ZIP (MZIPI), then displays the Transaction View screen with all populated fields

rules.rule_name: Transaction Amount Formatting for Display
rules.rule_description: The raw transaction amount retrieved from the data store is formatted into a display-ready format before being shown on the Transaction View screen.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully retrieved from the TRANSACT file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is preparing the transaction details for screen display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system moves the raw transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) into the working storage formatted amount field (WS-TRAN-AMT) and then moves the formatted amount (WS-TRAN-AMT) to the screen display field (TRNAMTI of COTRN1AI)

rules.rule_name: Navigate Back to Previous or Default Screen via PF3
rules.rule_description: Allows the user to navigate back to the screen they came from by pressing PF3. If no originating screen is recorded in the session, the user is directed to the Main Menu screen.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF3 (Go Back key)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If a calling program is recorded in the session context (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is not spaces or low-values), the system navigates to that calling program; if no calling program is recorded, the system navigates to the Main Menu screen (COMEN01C). In both cases, the current program name (WS-PGMNAME) is recorded as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), the current transaction ID (WS-TRANID) is recorded (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), and the program context is reset to zero (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT)

rules.rule_name: Navigate to Transaction List Screen via PF5
rules.rule_description: Allows the user to navigate directly to the Transaction List/Search screen by pressing PF5.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF5 (Transaction List key)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Transaction List screen (COTRN00C) and navigates the user there, passing the current session communication area

rules.rule_name: Clear Screen Fields and Reset Form via PF4
rules.rule_description: Allows the user to clear all input and display fields on the Transaction View screen, resetting it to a blank state ready for a new transaction search.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction View screen with data displayed or entered
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF4 (Clear key)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system clears all screen fields to spaces including: Transaction ID input (TRNIDINI), Transaction ID display (TRNIDI), Card Number (CARDNUMI), Transaction Type Code (TTYPCDI), Transaction Category Code (TCATCDI), Transaction Source (TRNSRCI), Transaction Amount (TRNAMTI), Transaction Description (TDESCI), Original Timestamp (TORIGDTI), Processed Timestamp (TPROCDTI), Merchant ID (MIDI), Merchant Name (MNAMEI), Merchant City (MCITYI), Merchant ZIP (MZIPI), and the message area (WS-MESSAGE); positions the cursor at the Transaction ID field (TRNIDINL set to -1); and redisplays the blank Transaction View screen

rules.rule_name: Invalid Key Press Handling
rules.rule_description: Handles any unsupported key press on the Transaction View screen by displaying an invalid key error message and keeping the user on the current screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
12:Invalid Key Handling
Show Invalid Key Error

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any key other than Enter, PF3, PF4, or PF5
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the standard invalid key error message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) in the message area, and redisplays the Transaction View screen with the current data unchanged

rules.rule_name: Screen Header Population with Current Date and Time
rules.rule_description: Every time the Transaction View screen is displayed, the screen header is refreshed with current system information including application titles, program identification, and the current date and time.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction View screen is about to be displayed to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the screen for display (SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN is performed)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the screen header with: Application Title Line 1 (CCDA-TITLE01 to TITLE01O), Application Title Line 2 (CCDA-TITLE02 to TITLE02O), current Transaction Name (WS-TRANID to TRNNAMEO), current Program Name (WS-PGMNAME to PGMNAMEO), current system date formatted as MM/DD/YY (to CURDATEO), and current system time formatted as HH:MM:SS (to CURTIMEO); and also moves the current error or informational message (WS-MESSAGE) to the screen error message field (ERRMSGO)

rules.rule_name: Detect Missing Session Data on Program Start
rules.rule_description: When the Transaction View program starts, it must verify that a valid communication area (session data) was passed from the calling program. If no session data is present, the program cannot proceed and must redirect the user to authenticate.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction View program (COTRN1AC) has just been invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: No session communication data is present (the length of the communication area passed to the program equals zero)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system determines that no valid session exists and initiates a redirect to the Sign-On screen; the program does not attempt to display the Transaction View screen or process any transaction data

rules.rule_name: Set Sign-On Screen as Redirect Destination When No Session Exists
rules.rule_description: When no valid session data is detected at program start, the system must designate the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C) as the target destination before performing the redirect, ensuring the user is sent to the correct authentication entry point.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction View program has determined that no valid session communication data is present (communication area length is zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to redirect the user away from the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C) so that the subsequent navigation action transfers the user to the correct authentication screen

rules.rule_name: Redirect Unauthenticated User to Sign-On Screen
rules.rule_description: When no valid session data exists at program entry, the system must immediately transfer control to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C), passing along the current session context information including the originating transaction ID and program name, so the user can authenticate and return to the appropriate screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Redirect User to Sign-On Screen COSGN00C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction View program has detected no valid session data and has designated COSGN00C as the destination; the current transaction ID (WS-TRANID) and program name (WS-PGMNAME) are available as originating context
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the redirect to the Sign-On screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system records the originating transaction ID (WS-TRANID) into the session context field CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, records the originating program name (WS-PGMNAME) into CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, resets the program context indicator to zero (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT = 0), and transfers full control to the Sign-On program (COSGN00C) passing the current session communication area; the Transaction View program is no longer active and the user is presented with the Sign-On screen

rules.rule_name: Fallback to Sign-On Screen if Destination Program is Undefined
rules.rule_description: As a safety measure during any redirect operation, if the destination program has not been explicitly set (is blank or contains low values), the system must default the destination to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C) to prevent navigation to an undefined or invalid program.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Redirect User to Sign-On Screen COSGN00C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is in the process of redirecting the user to another screen and the destination program field (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) has been evaluated
acceptance_criteria.When: The destination program field is found to contain low values or spaces (i.e., no valid destination program has been specified)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system overrides the destination and sets it to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C) before proceeding with the transfer of control, ensuring the user is always redirected to a valid and defined screen

rules.rule_name: Detect Pre-Selected Transaction ID on First Screen Entry
rules.rule_description: On the first entry to the Transaction View screen, the system checks whether a Transaction ID was passed from a previous transaction list screen. If a pre-selected Transaction ID exists, it is automatically loaded into the Transaction ID input field and the lookup is triggered without requiring manual user entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Was a Transaction ID Pre-Selected from Transaction List?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has arrived at the Transaction View screen for the first time (first entry flag is active) and the communication area contains a pre-selected Transaction ID (CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED is not equal to SPACES or LOW-VALUES) passed from the Transaction List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initializes the Transaction View screen on first entry
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system automatically populates the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINI) with the pre-selected Transaction ID value from CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED and immediately triggers the transaction lookup process without requiring the user to manually enter the Transaction ID or press Enter

rules.rule_name: Auto-Trigger Transaction Lookup for Pre-Selected Transaction
rules.rule_description: When a Transaction ID has been pre-selected and passed from the Transaction List screen, the system automatically invokes the transaction lookup process (PROCESS-ENTER-KEY) as if the user had manually entered the Transaction ID and pressed Enter, bypassing the need for manual interaction.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction View screen is being loaded for the first time and a valid pre-selected Transaction ID has been populated into the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINI) from the Transaction List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects that CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED is not SPACES or LOW-VALUES
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system automatically invokes the PROCESS-ENTER-KEY routine to perform the transaction lookup, equivalent to the user manually entering the Transaction ID and pressing the Enter key

rules.rule_name: Validate Transaction ID is Not Empty Before Lookup
rules.rule_description: Before performing a transaction lookup, the system validates that the Transaction ID field is not blank. If the Transaction ID is empty or contains only spaces or low-values, the lookup is blocked and an error message is displayed to the user.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction View screen and the transaction lookup process has been triggered either manually (Enter key) or automatically (pre-selection)
acceptance_criteria.When: The Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINI of COTRN1AI) contains only SPACES or LOW-VALUES (i.e., is empty or blank)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag (WS-ERR-FLG) to 'Y', displays the error message 'Tran ID can NOT be empty...' in the message area (WS-MESSAGE), positions the cursor on the Transaction ID input field, and redisplays the Transaction View screen without performing any transaction lookup

rules.rule_name: Search for Transaction Record in Transaction File
rules.rule_description: When a non-empty Transaction ID is provided, the system clears all existing transaction detail fields on the screen and performs a lookup of the transaction record in the Transaction file using the entered Transaction ID as the search key.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Search for Transaction in TRANSACT File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINI of COTRN1AI) contains a non-empty value and no prior validation error has been raised (ERR-FLG-ON is false)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system proceeds to look up the transaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system first clears all transaction detail display fields on the screen (TRNIDI, CARDNUMI, TTYPCDI, TCATCDI, TRNSRCI, TRNAMTI, TDESCI, TORIGDTI, TPROCDTI, MIDI, MNAMEI, MCITYI, MZIPI) to SPACES, then moves the entered Transaction ID from TRNIDINI to the search key field (TRAN-ID), and invokes the READ-TRANSACT-FILE routine to retrieve the transaction record from the Transaction file

rules.rule_name: Handle Transaction Not Found in Transaction File
rules.rule_description: When the entered Transaction ID does not match any record in the Transaction file, the system notifies the user that the transaction could not be found and prompts them to re-enter a valid Transaction ID.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has performed a lookup in the Transaction file using the entered Transaction ID (TRAN-ID)
acceptance_criteria.When: The Transaction file lookup returns a 'not found' response (no matching transaction record exists for the entered Transaction ID)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag (WS-ERR-FLG) to 'Y', displays the error message 'Transaction ID NOT found...' in the message area (WS-MESSAGE), positions the cursor on the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINL set to -1), and redisplays the Transaction View screen with no transaction details populated

rules.rule_name: Format Transaction Amount for Display
rules.rule_description: When a transaction record is successfully retrieved, the raw transaction amount from the transaction record is formatted into a display-ready format before being presented on the Transaction View screen.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully retrieved from the Transaction file and no error flag is active (ERR-FLG-ON is false)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the transaction details for display on the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system moves the raw transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) from the transaction record into the formatted working storage amount field (WS-TRAN-AMT), which is then used to populate the Transaction Amount display field (TRNAMTI of COTRN1AI) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display Full Transaction Details on Screen After Successful Lookup
rules.rule_description: When a transaction is successfully found in the Transaction file, all available transaction details including card information, merchant details, timestamps, and financial data are populated and displayed on the Transaction View screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Full Transaction Details on Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully retrieved from the Transaction file and no error flag is active (ERR-FLG-ON is false)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Transaction View screen with the retrieved transaction data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates and displays the following fields on the Transaction View screen: Transaction ID (TRNIDI from TRAN-ID), Card Number (CARDNUMI from TRAN-CARD-NUM), Transaction Type Code (TTYPCDI from TRAN-TYPE-CD), Transaction Category Code (TCATCDI from TRAN-CAT-CD), Transaction Source (TRNSRCI from TRAN-SOURCE), Transaction Amount (TRNAMTI from WS-TRAN-AMT), Transaction Description (TDESCI from TRAN-DESC), Original Transaction Timestamp (TORIGDTI from TRAN-ORIG-TS), Processed Transaction Timestamp (TPROCDTI from TRAN-PROC-TS), Merchant ID (MIDI from TRAN-MERCHANT-ID), Merchant Name (MNAMEI from TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME), Merchant City (MCITYI from TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY), and Merchant ZIP Code (MZIPI from TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP), and then sends the populated screen to the user

rules.rule_name: Display Empty Transaction View Screen Awaiting Manual Entry
rules.rule_description: When no Transaction ID has been pre-selected from a previous screen, or when an error has occurred during lookup, the Transaction View screen is displayed in a blank state with the cursor positioned on the Transaction ID field, awaiting manual input from the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Empty Screen Awaiting Manual Entry

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction View screen is being loaded for the first time AND either no Transaction ID was pre-selected (CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED equals SPACES or LOW-VALUES), OR a transaction lookup error has occurred (Transaction ID was empty or Transaction ID was not found in the Transaction file)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Transaction View screen to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the Transaction View screen with all transaction detail fields empty, the cursor positioned on the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINL set to -1), and any applicable error message shown in the message area (ERRMSGO of COTRN1AO), awaiting the user to manually enter a Transaction ID

rules.rule_name: Prevent Re-Initialization on Subsequent Screen Entries
rules.rule_description: When a user enters the Transaction View screen for the first time, the system marks the screen session as previously entered so that subsequent interactions do not re-initialize the screen and overwrite any user input or displayed data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Screen as Previously Entered to Prevent Re-Initialization

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has arrived at the Transaction View screen and the screen has NOT been previously marked as entered (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is FALSE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the first entry to the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the screen session flag to 'previously entered' (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER = TRUE) so that any subsequent interactions with the screen bypass the initialization logic and preserve the current screen state

rules.rule_name: Clear All Transaction View Screen Fields on First Entry
rules.rule_description: On the first entry to the Transaction View screen, all output screen fields are cleared to empty (LOW-VALUES) to ensure no residual or stale data from a previous session is displayed to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear All Screen Fields to Empty

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has arrived at the Transaction View screen for the first time (screen has not been previously entered)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initializes the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: All output fields on the Transaction View screen (COTRN1AO) are cleared to empty (LOW-VALUES), ensuring no previously displayed transaction data, messages, or field values are visible to the user

rules.rule_name: Set Cursor Focus to Transaction ID Input Field on Screen Load
rules.rule_description: When the Transaction View screen is first displayed, the cursor is automatically positioned in the Transaction ID input field to guide the user to enter the transaction they wish to view, improving usability and reducing navigation effort.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Cursor Focus to Transaction ID Input Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction View screen is being initialized for the first time
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the screen for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor focus is set to the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINL of COTRN1AI is set to -1), so that the user can immediately begin typing the Transaction ID without manually clicking or tabbing to the field

rules.rule_name: Populate Transaction View Screen Header with Application and Session Information
rules.rule_description: Every time the Transaction View screen is displayed, the screen header is populated with the application title lines, the current program name, the current transaction identifier, and the current system date and time to provide the user with contextual session information.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Screen Header Application Title, Program Name, Transaction ID, Current Date and Current Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction View screen is about to be displayed to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the screen header information
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following header fields are populated on the Transaction View screen (COTRN1AO): Application Title Line 1 (TITLE01O) is set from the application title constant (CCDA-TITLE01); Application Title Line 2 (TITLE02O) is set from the application title constant (CCDA-TITLE02); Transaction Name (TRNNAMEO) is set to the current transaction identifier (WS-TRANID); Program Name (PGMNAMEO) is set to the current program name (WS-PGMNAME); Current Date (CURDATEO) is set to the system date formatted as MM/DD/YY; Current Time (CURTIMEO) is set to the system time formatted as HH:MM:SS

rules.rule_name: Display Transaction View Screen to User

rules.rule_name: Capture User Input from Transaction View Screen
rules.rule_description: When a returning user submits the Transaction View screen, the system must capture all data entered by the user on the screen into the transaction input map (COTRN1AI) before any processing or routing occurs.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture All Data Entered on Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has previously loaded the Transaction View screen (the program has been re-entered, i.e., CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is TRUE) and has entered data on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the Transaction View screen by pressing any key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures all data entered on the screen into the transaction input map (COTRN1AI), including the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINI) and all other screen fields, making the data available for subsequent processing

rules.rule_name: Capture Transaction ID Input Field from Screen
rules.rule_description: The Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINI) entered by the user on the Transaction View screen is captured as part of the screen receive operation and is the primary key field used for transaction lookup processing.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a value (or left blank) in the Transaction ID input field on the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system receives the submitted Transaction View screen data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction ID value entered by the user is captured in the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINI of COTRN1AI) and is available for validation and lookup processing

rules.rule_name: Route to Transaction ID Lookup on ENTER Key
rules.rule_description: When the user presses the ENTER key on the Transaction View screen, the system routes to the transaction lookup process to search for the transaction record matching the entered Transaction ID.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction View screen with data captured in COTRN1AI
acceptance_criteria.When: The action key pressed is the ENTER key (EIBAID = DFHENTER)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system invokes the transaction ID lookup process (PROCESS-ENTER-KEY) to validate the Transaction ID and retrieve the matching transaction record

rules.rule_name: Navigate Back to Previous Screen on PF3 Key
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 on the Transaction View screen, the system navigates back to the originating screen. If no originating screen is recorded, the system defaults to the Main Menu screen.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction View screen with data captured in COTRN1AI
acceptance_criteria.When: The action key pressed is PF3 (EIBAID = DFHPF3)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system checks the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM): if it is populated (not SPACES or LOW-VALUES), the user is navigated to that originating program; if it is empty (SPACES or LOW-VALUES), the user is navigated to the Main Menu screen (COMEN01C). In both cases, the current program name (WS-PGMNAME) is recorded as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), the current transaction ID (WS-TRANID) is recorded as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), and the program context (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT) is reset to zero before navigation

rules.rule_name: Clear Transaction View Screen on PF4 Key
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF4 on the Transaction View screen, the system clears all input and display fields on the screen and redisplays a blank Transaction View screen ready for new input.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction View screen with data captured in COTRN1AI
acceptance_criteria.When: The action key pressed is PF4 (EIBAID = DFHPF4)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system clears all screen fields to spaces including: Transaction ID input (TRNIDINI), Transaction ID display (TRNIDI), Card Number (CARDNUMI), Transaction Type Code (TTYPCDI), Transaction Category Code (TCATCDI), Transaction Source (TRNSRCI), Transaction Amount (TRNAMTI), Transaction Description (TDESCI), Original Transaction Timestamp (TORIGDTI), Processed Transaction Timestamp (TPROCDTI), Merchant ID (MIDI), Merchant Name (MNAMEI), Merchant City (MCITYI), Merchant ZIP (MZIPI), and the message area (WS-MESSAGE). The cursor is repositioned to the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINL set to -1), and the blank Transaction View screen is redisplayed

rules.rule_name: Navigate to Transaction List Screen on PF5 Key
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF5 on the Transaction View screen, the system navigates the user to the Transaction List screen (COTRN00C).

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction View screen with data captured in COTRN1AI
acceptance_criteria.When: The action key pressed is PF5 (EIBAID = DFHPF5)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Transaction List screen (COTRN00C), records the current program name (WS-PGMNAME) as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), records the current transaction ID (WS-TRANID) as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), resets the program context (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT) to zero, and navigates the user to the Transaction List screen (COTRN00C)

rules.rule_name: Display Invalid Key Message for Unsupported Key Press
rules.rule_description: When the user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF4, or PF5 on the Transaction View screen, the system treats it as an invalid action and displays an error message to inform the user.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction View screen with data captured in COTRN1AI
acceptance_criteria.When: The action key pressed is any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF4, or PF5
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y' (WS-ERR-FLG = 'Y'), populates the message area with the standard invalid key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) in WS-MESSAGE, and redisplays the Transaction View screen with the error message shown in the error message output field (ERRMSGO of COTRN1AO), leaving all previously entered data unchanged

rules.rule_name: Transaction ID Presence Validation
rules.rule_description: The system must verify that the Transaction ID field contains a value before attempting any transaction record lookup. The field must not be empty or contain only blank spaces.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Transaction ID Empty or Blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction View screen and has pressed the ENTER key to initiate a transaction lookup
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the Transaction ID input field and finds it contains only spaces or is completely empty (blank/low-values)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system identifies this as an invalid submission and triggers the empty Transaction ID error handling process

rules.rule_name: Error Flag Activation on Empty Transaction ID
rules.rule_description: When the Transaction ID field is found to be empty or blank upon ENTER key press, the system must activate the error flag to prevent any further processing such as transaction record lookup.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed ENTER on the Transaction View screen and the Transaction ID field is empty or contains only blank spaces
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects the Transaction ID field is empty or blank (SPACES or LOW-VALUES)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to ON (WS-ERR-FLG = 'Y'), which blocks all subsequent transaction lookup processing from executing

rules.rule_name: Error Message Assignment for Empty Transaction ID
rules.rule_description: When the Transaction ID field is empty or blank, the system must assign a specific user-facing error message to inform the user that the Transaction ID is a required field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: 'Tran ID can NOT be empty...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed ENTER on the Transaction View screen and the Transaction ID field is empty or contains only blank spaces
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects the Transaction ID field is empty or blank (SPACES or LOW-VALUES)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the screen error message to exactly 'Tran ID can NOT be empty...' which will be displayed in the error message area (ERRMSGO) of the Transaction View screen

rules.rule_name: Cursor Return to Transaction ID Field on Validation Error
rules.rule_description: After detecting an empty Transaction ID and setting the error message, the system must return the cursor focus to the Transaction ID input field and display the screen with the error message, guiding the user to correct the missing value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Return Cursor Focus to Transaction ID Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has detected that the Transaction ID field is empty or blank and has set the error flag and error message
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to redisplay the Transaction View screen with the validation error
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system positions the cursor on the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINL set to -1 to indicate cursor placement) and immediately displays the Transaction View screen showing the error message 'Tran ID can NOT be empty...' in the error message area, keeping the user on the same screen to correct the input

rules.rule_name: Cursor Retention on Transaction ID Field for Valid Input
rules.rule_description: When the Transaction ID field contains a valid non-empty value, the system still positions the cursor on the Transaction ID field as a default cursor placement before proceeding to the transaction record lookup.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Return Cursor Focus to Transaction ID Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed ENTER on the Transaction View screen and the Transaction ID field contains a non-empty, non-blank value
acceptance_criteria.When: The system confirms the Transaction ID field has a value (not SPACES or LOW-VALUES)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the cursor position to the Transaction ID input field (TRNIDINL set to -1) and continues processing without setting any error flag or error message, allowing the transaction lookup to proceed

rules.rule_name: Proceed to Transaction Record Lookup After Successful Validation
rules.rule_description: When the Transaction ID field passes validation (is not empty or blank) and no error flag has been raised, the system must use the entered Transaction ID as the search key and initiate the transaction record lookup process.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a non-empty Transaction ID on the Transaction View screen and pressed ENTER, and the error flag is not active (no prior validation errors exist)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system confirms no error flag is set (ERR-FLG-ON is false) after the Transaction ID presence validation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system clears all transaction detail display fields on the screen (Transaction ID, Card Number, Transaction Type Code, Transaction Category Code, Transaction Source, Transaction Amount, Transaction Description, Original Transaction Timestamp, Processed Transaction Timestamp, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, Merchant ZIP), copies the entered Transaction ID as the lookup key, and initiates the transaction record lookup (READ-TRANSACT-FILE), continuing to Business Process 6

rules.rule_name: Search TRANSACT File to Retrieve Full Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The system searches the TRANSACT VSAM file using the Transaction ID as the unique key to retrieve the complete transaction record for display to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Search TRANSACT File Using Transaction ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Transaction ID has been set as the search key

acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the error flag to ON ('Y'), (2) display the error message 'Transaction ID NOT found...' on the screen, (3) return the cursor focus to the Transaction ID input field, and (4) redisplay the Transaction View screen with the error message visible to the user

rules.rule_name: Format Transaction Amount for Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully retrieved from the TRANSACT file

acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must move the raw transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) into the formatted working storage amount field (WS-TRAN-AMT) which applies the appropriate sign and decimal notation, and then use the formatted value (WS-TRAN-AMT) to populate the Transaction Amount display field (TRNAMTI) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Populate All Transaction Details on Screen After Successful Retrieval
rules.rule_description: Upon successfully retrieving a transaction record from the TRANSACT file, all available transaction details must be populated into the corresponding screen display fields so the user can view the complete transaction information.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 7: Populate All Transaction Details on Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully retrieved from the TRANSACT file and the transaction amount has been formatted
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Transaction View screen with the retrieved data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must populate the following screen fields with the corresponding values from the retrieved transaction record: Transaction ID display field (TRNIDI) from TRAN-ID, Card Number field (CARDNUMI) from TRAN-CARD-NUM, Transaction Type Code field (TTYPCDI) from TRAN-TYPE-CD, Transaction Category Code field (TCATCDI) from TRAN-CAT-CD, Transaction Source field (TRNSRCI) from TRAN-SOURCE, Transaction Amount field (TRNAMTI) from the formatted WS-TRAN-AMT, Transaction Description field (TDESCI) from TRAN-DESC, Original Transaction Timestamp field (TORIGDTI) from TRAN-ORIG-TS, Processed Transaction Timestamp field (TPROCDTI) from TRAN-PROC-TS, Merchant ID field (MIDI) from TRAN-MERCHANT-ID, Merchant Name field (MNAMEI) from TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME, Merchant City field (MCITYI) from TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY, and Merchant ZIP field (MZIPI) from TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP

rules.rule_name: Navigate Back to Calling Program When Origin is Recorded
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 and the system has a record of which program launched the Transaction View screen, the navigation destination is set to that originating calling program.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction View screen and the calling program identifier (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) is recorded and is not empty or blank
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF3 to navigate back
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the navigation destination to the recorded calling program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), so the user is returned to the exact screen that originally launched the Transaction View screen

rules.rule_name: Default Navigation to Main Menu When No Calling Program is Recorded

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction View screen and the calling program identifier (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) is empty or blank (no originating program was recorded)

rules.rule_name: Fallback Safety Default to Sign-On Screen When Destination is Unresolved
rules.rule_description: As a final safety measure before executing navigation, if the destination program is still empty or blank after the PF3 destination-setting logic, the system defaults the destination to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C) to prevent navigation failure.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Destination to Calling Program / Set Destination to Main Menu Screen COMEN01C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The navigation back process has been triggered and the destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) is still empty or blank after the PF3 destination-setting logic
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is about to execute the navigation transfer
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system overrides the empty destination and sets it to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C), ensuring navigation always has a valid target

rules.rule_name: Record Current Program and Transaction ID Before Navigating Away
rules.rule_description: Before navigating away from the Transaction View screen, the system records the current program name and current transaction identifier into the shared session context, so that the destination screen knows where the user came from and can support a return journey if needed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Record Current Program and Transaction ID for Return Journey

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 and the navigation destination has been determined
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is preparing to transfer control to the destination screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system records the current Transaction View program name (WS-PGMNAME) into the session's originating program field (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), records the current transaction identifier (WS-TRANID) into the session's originating transaction ID field (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), and resets the program context indicator (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT) to zero, so the destination screen has full context of the navigation origin

rules.rule_name: Execute Transfer of Control to Destination Screen
rules.rule_description: After the destination has been determined and the current program context has been recorded, the system transfers full control to the destination screen, passing along the complete session communication area so that all session state is preserved across the navigation.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The navigation destination program has been determined and the current program context (program name, transaction ID, program context indicator) has been recorded in the session communication area
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the navigation transfer
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system transfers full control to the resolved destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM), passing the complete session communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) so that all session data, user context, and navigation history are available to the destination screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to redisplay the Transaction View screen after an unrecognized key press
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen header population routine is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the current system date and time and populates the screen header with: application title lines (CCDA-TITLE01, CCDA-TITLE02), current transaction name (WS-TRANID), current program name (WS-PGMNAME), current date formatted as MM/DD/YY (WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY), and current time formatted as HH:MM:SS (WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS)

rules.rule_name: Display Invalid Key Error Message in Screen Error Area
rules.rule_description: The invalid key error message staged in the working message area must be transferred to the designated error message display field on the Transaction View screen so the user can see it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Place Error Message in Screen Error Message Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has loaded the invalid key error message into the working message area (WS-MESSAGE) and is preparing to send the Transaction View screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen send routine is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system moves the contents of WS-MESSAGE into the screen error message output field (ERRMSGO of COTRN1AO) so the error message is visible to the user on the screen

rules.rule_name: Redisplay Transaction View Screen with Existing Data Unchanged
rules.rule_description: After an unrecognized key press, the Transaction View screen must be redisplayed with all previously entered or displayed data intact — only the error message is added. No data fields are cleared or modified.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Redisplay Transaction View Screen with All Existing Data Unchanged

acceptance_criteria.Given: The error flag is active, the invalid key error message is in the screen error field, and the screen header has been refreshed with current date and time
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Transaction View screen (map COTRN1A from mapset COTRN01) to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction View screen is redisplayed with: all previously entered or displayed transaction data fields remaining unchanged, the error message 'Invalid Key' visible in the error message area, the cursor positioned as last set, and the screen fully refreshed (ERASE)
